purpose: Trigger-collision fixtures. Each cluster is a set of skills whose descriptions compete for the same natural-language intents — the places where a routing mistake is plausible rather than exotic. Every case names the skill that should win; every OTHER skill in the same cluster is an implicit must-NOT-trigger for that phrasing. These fixtures are the pass/fail gate for any rewrite of a skill's `description`: change a description, replay the cases, and a regression shows up as a phrasing that now routes to a cluster sibling. Author the fixture BEFORE touching a description, never after — a gate written to match the new behavior grades nothing.
